messages:
alex kim: Evening handoff — quick capacity/quotas note for the night. Pool C3-48 at 72% now, 12 GPU burst headroom. Watching a scheduled Acme batch job at 00:10 UTC that could push short spikes.

alex kim: Action items: 1) Watch burst usage metric and let me know if we hit >85%. 2) If we see sustained >80% for >5m, open a temporary swap and ping infra. 3) Don’t preempt anything labeled "priority: enterprise" unless we coordinate.

alex kim: Dashboards: https://console.redwood.com/dashboard?pool=C3-48 — main graphs are token/sec and burst_pct. Alerts are: burst_warning at 80%, burst_critical at 90%.

oncall-bot: [alert] 1809995380 - burst_warning: pool C3-48 at 82% (rolling 2m).

maya singh: Seeing the bot alert. I'm going to check the job queue and rate-limit window. If that Acme export is the culprit we can throttle to 60qps for 15m.

alex kim: Good call. If you throttle, please note in the incident log (non-incident) and add the job id.

maya singh: quick note: I throttled the job (job id acl-2026-45) to 45 qps at 00:12 UTC. burst dropped to 68% within 90s. Added a comment to the ticket. :white_check_mark:

samira: FYI, we have a model canary rolling at 03:30 UTC (low traffic path). It warms KV caches — expect a small spike ~2-3 GPUs for ~2 minutes. Not expected to trigger alarms but wanted to flag.

dmitri ivanov: I'll be available on Slack from 02:00-04:00 if you need help with a swap. If it looks like sustained >85% i'll take the swap.

alex kim: Thanks — scope: don't swap unless sustained >85% for 10m or a >90% spike. If you swap, set preempt_policy=soft and keep node labels (no-evict) for enterprise workloads.

maya singh: Also noticed quota alerts for pool C2-22 this morning; filed ticket #1234 to request +6 GPUs for next week planned load. Not blocking tonight but putting on radar.

alex kim: Good. One more ask: if you see the burst_critical alert, escalate to oncall manager @dmitri and post a short summary in #incidents (title: "C3-48 critical burst - <time>").

oncall-bot: [info] reminder: night handoff checklist — set pager schedule, check scheduled jobs, verify quotas (https://console.redwood.com/oncall/checklist).

maya singh: Copy. I'll monitor until 02:00 and then hand over. If anything changes I'll ping here with timestamps and actions.

alex kim: Appreciate it. Leaving handoff open until 02:00. Thanks all. :coffee:
